children.value: Welcome to the new world... whoever you are.
Legend says that an important historic figure's descendant is living amongst us...
I believe we are stuck in a time paradox.
If you ever ask yourself, "What is life?" answer to yourself: "Life is life."
Have you ever been out of the Mainmap? I recommend exploring the Offmap and beyond.
I ate something... and it didn't sit well with me...
I am an NPC. Whatever that means...
I've never been to the Oracle. I wonder what it's like there...
Where's my son? Wait. I don't have one.
